description: Search USDA FoodData Central and Open Food Facts for foods matching a query. Returns candidates with macros per 100 g, a `source`, and, when known, `serving_grams`/`serving_label` for one household serving. Curated chain-menu candidates include a `provenance` object that may carry a portion caveat. All calorie and macro values, including carbohydrates, are estimates from USDA FoodData Central, Open Food Facts, the user's own entry or an AI assistant's estimate — approximate, not lab-measured or specific to a package or batch, and not suitable for insulin dosing (including carb counting for a meal bolus), blood-glucose prediction or any other medical decision.

limit.description: Max candidates to return (default 5, clamped to 1–10).

query.description: Food to search, e.g. 'greek yogurt' or 'Chipotle chicken'.

name: search_foods

items.description: A food match. Macros are PER 100 g — scale to the portion before logging.

macros.description: Calories and macros. Estimates, not lab-measured; not for insulin dosing.
